title: Engineering-Semantic Retrieval of Bridge Defects for Visual Inspection Archives
description: Code and reproducibility materials for bridge-defect retrieval with engineering-semantic supervision. The repository includes training and evaluation scripts, experiment configurations, retrieval split manifests, metrics, and analysis figures used in the manuscript.
